name: other5
label: Person #5 is other type of acquaintance

questions.text:
Here is a list of some of the ways in which people are connected to each other. Some people can be connected to you In more than one way. For example, a man could be your brother and he may belong to your church and be your lawyer. 
When I read you a name, please tell me all the ways that person is connected to you.
How is (NAME) connected to you?  PROBE:  What other ways?  ASK FOR EACH NAME.
